context:
Work in parallel where possible: w2 (archive clutter) and w3 (move ADRs) and w4 (move analysis docs)
have no mutual dependencies and can be done in any order or simultaneously in one commit.
w1 (research gate) must complete before w5. w6 (stale reference scan) must run after all moves.

Rule of thumb for the research gate: if a file's last git commit is >90 days old AND no open
TODO item explicitly depends on it, treat it as archivable. If a file is referenced by grep hits
outside _project/, it is misplaced and should move to docs/.

For reference updates: update live docs (docs/, results-data/, AGENTS.md) but do NOT update
_project/handoffs/ - those are historical records where broken internal links are acceptable.

Stage files explicitly by path (never `git add -A`). Use `git mv` not `cp` + `rm` for all
file relocations to preserve history. Bundle w2 + w3 + w4 into a single commit if they have
no reference-update entanglements; otherwise separate for clarity.
description:
The `_project/` directory was designed as a scratch/transient working area.
A 2026-04-15 audit revealed it now contains a mix of intentional permanent
assets and misplaced canonical ones:

CONFIRMED CLUTTER (unambiguous - archive or delete):
  - 3 superseded monolithic TODO YAMLs totalling ~1.1 MB
    (PROJECT_TODO.yaml, PROJECT_DONE.yaml, PROJECT_TODO.yaml.before-fix)
  - 10 MB coverage.json (generated artifact, should not be tracked in git)
  - 2 timing report text files (generated output, reproducible)
  - 1 POC script (dataframe_poc.py, superseded by production code)
  - 1 one-off analysis artifact (reclassification.yaml)

CONFIRMED MISPLACED (should live in docs/):
  - _project/adr/ - 2 ADRs belong in docs/development/adr/
  - _project/analysis/hosted-results-contract.md - live contract referenced by
    results-data/README.md and docs/operations/results-phase-2-runbook.md
  - _project/analysis/threat-model.md - canonical security doc
  - _project/analysis/benchbox-results-platform-strategy.md - active strategy doc

OPEN QUESTIONS requiring a research gate (see w1):
  - _project/specs/ (30+ files, 1.7 MB) - authoritative or internal-only?
  - _project/DESIGN-integrated-task-management.md - stays near the TODO system
    it describes, or moves to docs/development/?
  - _project/PLATFORM_INTEGRATION_ROADMAP.md, RELEASE_PRIORITIZATION_v1.md,
    PRE_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md - active agent reference artifacts or publishable docs?
  - _project/DATAFRAME_SUPPORT_MASTER.md + format-converter/query-plan docs -
    live architecture references or completed-milestone archives?
  - _project/handoffs/ - active context for in-flight work or historical records?

INTENTIONALLY STAYS in _project/ (do not touch):
  - _project/scripts/ - isolated pyproject.toml prevents dependency leakage into
    the main wheel; invocation `uv run --project _project/scripts` is canonical
  - _project/config/ - config for the scripts above; co-located by design
  - _project/TODO_SCHEMA.yaml, TODO_ENTRY_TEMPLATE.yaml - used by validate_todo.py
  - _project/TODO/, _project/DONE/ - the active project management system
  - _project/scratch/, _project/notes/, _project/_archive/, _project/_trash/

anti_patterns.dont: archive or move PROJECT_TODO.yaml and PROJECT_DONE.yaml without git mv
anti_patterns.instead: always use git mv even when moving to _archive/
anti_patterns.why: git rm + git add would lose file history

anti_patterns.dont: attempt to condense DATAFRAME_SUPPORT_MASTER.md into a short docs page without the research gate confirming it is still actively consulted
anti_patterns.why: if it's unused, plain archiving is the right call

anti_patterns.instead: the research gate (w1) must answer this first
anti_patterns.why: specs may be internal-only design notes that would be inappropriate to publish in docs/

anti_patterns.instead: moving them would break every command in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
anti_patterns.why: they form an intentionally isolated Python environment with `uv run --project _project/scripts` as the canonical invocation

anti_patterns.instead: stale links in historical docs are acceptable
anti_patterns.why: those are historical records and patching them wastes time with no benefit
this repo has strict per-file staging policy and generated files could accidentally be staged

A grep-based CI step could catch future cases where docs are created inside
_project/ and linked from outside. Deferred because it requires writing a
check_project_references.py script and wiring it into the Makefile - small
enough to add as a follow-up TODO once this cleanup is done.

The 67 KB master doc is dense. Breaking it into per-topic pages in docs/

work_units.notes:
Apply one of the classified actions per research gate outcome. The exact moves
depend entirely on w1 findings - the options are specified here:

FOR _project/specs/ - pick ONE:
  Option A (authoritative content not in docs/):
    For each unique spec file: git mv _project/specs/{name}.md docs/benchmarks/{name}.md
    OR git mv _project/specs/platforms/{name}.md docs/platforms/{name}.md
    Archive anything already covered: git mv _project/specs/{dup}.md _project/_archive/specs/{dup}.md
  Option B (internal design notes only):
    Write _project/specs/README.md: "Internal design notes - not published. See docs/ for authoritative content."
    No moves needed.
  Option C (superseded by public docs):
    git mv _project/specs/ _project/_archive/specs/

FOR _project/DESIGN-integrated-task-management.md - pick ONE:
  Option A (agent navigation reference → stay in _project/): no action.
  Option B (publishable architecture doc → move):
    git mv _project/DESIGN-integrated-task-management.md docs/development/task-management-design.md
    grep -rn "DESIGN-integrated-task-management" . --include="*.md" --include="*.py" --include="*.yaml"
    Update any hits.

  Option A (agent-facing action lists → stay in _project/): no action.
  Option B (publishable → merge/move to docs/development/):
    git mv each file to appropriate docs/ path.
  Option C (completed milestones → archive):
    git mv each file to _project/_archive/

FOR _project/DATAFRAME_SUPPORT_MASTER.md + FORMAT_CONVERTER_*.md + query_plan_*.md - pick ONE per file:
  Option A (not consulted in >90 days, no open TODO dependency): git mv to _project/_archive/
